F1: isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)` at addGuests.handler.ts:46-48 only passes OWNER, since `isTeamOwner` matches role OWNER alone, so team ADMINs get FORBIDDEN.
F2: the blacklist is lowercased but compared with the raw guest via `includes(guest)`, with no lowercasing or `extractBaseEmail`, unlike handleNewBooking.ts:742-743.
F3: attendees are written first, `updateCalendarAttendees` returns void and `updateAllCalendarEvents` catches its own errors into `success: false` results, so the handler returns "Guests added" regardless.
F4: the catch at addGuests.handler.ts:169-171 discards `err`, logs only a fixed string, and the handler still returns success.
F5: the server schema has no uniqueness check, the filter only excludes existing attendees case-sensitively, and Attendee has no unique constraint, so `createMany` inserts duplicate rows.
F6: the handler passes raw `guests` rather than `uniqueGuests` to `sendAddGuestsEmails`, so an existing attendee in the request matches `newGuests.includes` and gets `AttendeeScheduledEmail`.
F7: sendAddGuestsEmails` takes no event-type metadata and sends host and attendee emails unconditionally, while `sendLocationChangeEmails` beside it applies the disable gates.
F8: the handler checks only permissions and never looks at `booking.status` or `endTime`, so a direct call on a cancelled or past booking adds attendees and sends emails.
F9: an attendee-email match is enough to pass, the guests array has no `.max()`, and the mutation runs on plain `authedProcedure` with no rate limiting, so sends to arbitrary addresses are unbounded.
F10: you_do_not_have_permission` is absent from en/common.json and the dialog shows `t(err.message)`, so the toast displays the raw key.
F11: both new templates pass the raw key as `subject`, which overrides via `{...props}` and reaches `<title>` through `props.subject || subject` and `EmailHead`.
F12: organizer-add-guests-email.ts:23 uses `APP_NAME` for the sender, while the parent organizer-scheduled-email.ts:47 uses `EMAIL_FROM_NAME`, so a configured sender name is ignored for this email.
F13: the dialog is always mounted and `isInvalidEmail` is reset only by Cancel, so the error persists after success or outside-close; the template-literal message is always truthy, making the fallback unreachable.
F14: the new MultiEmail.tsx:46 hardcodes `content="Remove email"` while the rest of the component uses `t()`, so non-English locales see English text.
